Author: unknown
Name: Auto Craft Cycle
Description: Repeats material restocking and crafting in inn rooms, collectable deliveries, scrip exchanges, and optional Grand Company deliveries. Supports IPC integration with other plugins.
Punchline: Automates material restocking, crafting, collectable delivery, and scrip exchange.
Changelog: Adds cycle/date stop reservations, per-run completion actions, result Discord webhooks, richer target context and history, craftable counts, missing-material registration and replenishment controls.

Author: unknown
Name: Submarine Sell Item Tracker
Description: Tracks submarine salvage accessories, item counts, and NPC sale values across characters. Includes automatic scans, service account and world summaries, CSV export, and AutoRetainer completion reports through Discord webhooks. Use /subinv to open or /subinv settings to configure notifications.
Punchline: Track submarine salvage items and sale values across characters.
Changelog: Adds AutoRetainer submarine completion detection, Japan-time start-date report IDs, Discord webhook settings and connection tests, persistent report state, duplicate-report prevention, and automatic retries.
